import random

def get_unique_greeting(name):
    """Generates a semi-randomized, unique sounding greeting."""
    greetings = [
        f"Greetings, {name}! May your day be filled with code and coffee.",
        f"Hello there, {name}. It's wonderful to see you again!",
        f"Salutations, {name}! Wishing you success in all endeavors.",
        f"Hey {name}, hope everything is running smoothly for you today.",
        f"Welcome back, {name}! Keep coding and conquering."
    ]
    return random.choice(greetings)

def main():
    """Main function to interact with the user."""
    print("--- Unique Greeting Generator ---")
    
    while True:
        # Get input from the user
        user_input = input("\nPlease enter your name (or type 'exit' to quit): ").strip()
        
        # Check for exit condition
        if user_input.lower() == 'exit':
            print("\nGoodbye! Have a wonderful day.")
            break
        
        # Validate input 
        if not user_input:
            print("Please enter a valid name or type 'exit'.")
            continue

        name = user_input
        
        # Generate and print the unique greeting
        greeting = get_unique_greeting(name)
        print("\n=========================================")
        print(f"✨ {greeting} ✨")
        print("=========================================\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
